battle.name: 羅斯人遠征裏海 (943年)
battle.brief: 公元943年，基輔王公伊戈爾集結羅斯、瓦良格與楚德戰士，沿頓河下亞速海，繞克里米亞半島進入裏海，掠奪阿蘭的巴達與薛凡沿岸城邑，回程船隊散架、人員潰散。卡面的羅馬弩砲早已廢棄千年，本役攻城靠的是隨船運來的攻城塔與火攻器具。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 這場戰爭是十世紀中葉基輔羅斯公國對裏海西南岸的塞人—阿拉伯領地發動的一次大規模掠奪性遠征，發生在公元943年，編年史把它繫於九四三至九四四年前後的那幾條之下，具體歸年至今有爭議。羅斯一方並非單一民族的王家軍隊，而是以瓦良格人出身的基輔王公伊戈爾為首、由羅斯人、瓦良格人、斯拉夫人、楚德人（芬蘭—烏戈爾語族）、克里維奇人與佩琴涅革人拼成的戰團：核心是一支規模不詳但裝備齊全的乘船瓦良格式步騎手隊伍，配上斯拉夫與楚德步兵；隊伍分成水陸兩支，水軍用平底河船改裝的近海帆船，陸軍沿頓河與黑海北岸的草原行軍，兩路在裏海西岸會合。對手是環繞裏海的幾股勢力：高加索的塞人國家阿蘭（亞拉尼亞，首府巴達，即今阿塞拜疆的巴爾達）、阿拔斯朝邊疆的薛凡總督區（節爾凡）、阿蘭人與卡斯俄克人（欽察草原上的部落），以及控制頓河下游、伏爾加河口與北高加索的哈察爾汗國。哈察爾人既是他們的保護人也是被打擊的對象：羅斯人沿頓河與伏爾加推進，等於直接挑戰哈察爾人對黑海—裏海航線的壟斷。拜占庭帝國此時是羅斯人最熟悉的遠方強敵，也是裏海東岸通往巴格達的商路上無法忽略的一環；十世紀初的阿拉伯地理學家伊本·魯斯塔與馬蘇第都記錄了裏海周邊的航路、部眾與貿易，構成本役的外部記錄。
countriesEn: This war was a large-scale predatory expedition launched in the middle of the tenth century by the Kievan Rus' against the Sasanian-Arab territories on the southwestern shore of the Caspian Sea, fought in AD 943; the chronicles file it under the entries covering roughly 943 and 944, and its exact dating remains disputed. The Rus' side was not a homogeneous royal army but a warband led by Igor, the Kiev prince of Varangian origin, patched together from Rus' and Varangian warriors, Slavs, Chuds (Finnic-Ugric peoples), Krivichians and Pechenegs: the core was a ship-borne force of Varangian-style foot and mounted warriors of unknown but solid size, reinforced by Slavic and Chud infantry. The force was split into a water column and a land column, the seamen in flat-bottomed river boats converted into coastal sailing craft, the foot and horse following the Don and the steppe north of the Black Sea, the two columns joining on the western shore of the Caspian. The opponents were the powers ringing the Caspian: the Sasanian-derived Albanian state of Arran (capital at Barda, in modern Azerbaijan), the Abbasid frontier governorship of Shirvan (Derbent), the Alans and the Kasogues (peoples of the Pontic steppe), and the Khazar Khaganate, which controlled the lower Don, the mouth of the Volga and the northern Caucasus. The Khazars were at once the Rus' protectors and their target: pushing down the Don and the Volga meant challenging the Khazar monopoly on the Black Sea-Caspian route. Byzantium was the distant power the Rus' knew best and also the missing link in the chain of trade running from the eastern Caspian to Baghdad; the tenth-century Arab geographers Ibn Rustah and Mas'udi both recorded the routes, peoples and commerce of the Caspian littoral, and they supply the outside record of this campaign.
people: 事件的核心人物是伊戈爾·羅列諾維奇（Igor of Kiev，瓦良格語名作 Ingvar），約生於八七〇年代末，九一二年起執掌基輔。他並非以領兵掠海著稱的君主：現存編年史對他九一二至九四一年之間的記載幾近空白，他之所以留名，主要來自九四一年與九四四年兩度兵臨君士坦丁堡，以及九四五年與拜占庭皇帝君士坦丁七世訂立的條約，而這些都發生在本役之後或前後。學者對九四三年這支遠征隊伍究竟由伊戈爾率領、還是由其兄弟奧列格或另一支羅斯王公的隊伍執行，意見不一；拜占庭史料亦只說羅斯人劫掠了裏海的阿拉伯人，未必點名伊戈爾。另一個關鍵人物是他的寡婦奧爾加：她在伊戈爾被德列夫利人殺死後主持復仇，改變了徵貢方式，又促成九四五年的條約，使羅斯與拜占庭的關係由掠奪轉為結盟。對面的哈察爾汗國由可汗的屬官執事掌握軍權；阿蘭與薛凡的守軍由當地塞人貴族與阿拔斯王朝任命的總督（Marzbān）率領，但編年史沒有留下他們的姓名。哈察爾人因九世紀末曾大敗羅斯人而在北高加索享有威名，十世紀上半葉則主要靠外交與屏障維持霸權。奧列格九一二年沿第聶伯河南下的遠征以隱蔽取勝——船隊藏進船艙、假稱是往希臘經商者，騙開基輔城門——常被後世拿來與這次海陸並進的遠征相提並論，但兩次的戰略完全不同：奧列格靠的是隱蔽與突襲，伊戈爾這次靠的是艦隊與騎兵的正面機動。
peopleEn: The central figure is Igor Rurikovich (Igor of Kiev, whose Old Norse name was Ingvar), born around the late 870s and holding the Kievan throne from 912. He was not a prince famous for leading raids on the sea: the surviving chronicles say almost nothing about him between 912 and 941, and his fame rests on the two strikes at Constantinople in 941 and 944 and on the treaty he concluded with the Byzantine emperor Constantine VII in 945, events that came after or around this campaign. Scholars disagree over whether the expedition of 943 was actually led by Igor, by his brother Oleg, or by the warband of another Rus' prince, and the Byzantine sources say only that the Rus' plundered the Arabs on the Caspian without necessarily naming Igor. The other key figure is his widow Olga, who after Igor's murder at the hands of the Drevlians organised the revenge, reformed the collection of tribute, and pushed through the treaty of 945 that turned Rus'-Byzantine relations from plunder into alliance. On the opposing side the Khazar Khaganate kept its war power in the hands of a beg at the Khazar court; the defenders of Arran and Shirvan were commanded by local Sasanian-derived nobles and by the Abbasid-appointed governor (marzbān), though the chronicles preserve none of their names. The Khazars had a reputation in the northern Caucasus from their crushing victory over the Rus' at the end of the ninth century, and in the first half of the tenth century they maintained their hegemony mainly through diplomacy and buffer zones. Oleg's expedition down the Dnieper in 912, which won by concealment and surprise, with the warband hidden in the holds and a false tale of a trading voyage to Greece, is often compared with this combined sea-and-land raid, yet the two strategies are quite different: Oleg relied on stealth and a sudden entry, while Igor's men of 943 relied on the open manoeuvring of a fleet and of mounted columns.
kits: 這張卡上的羅馬弩砲（Scorpio）是本戰役的年代對照物：扭力蓄能的投射機，一發一具箭，公元前一世紀末至五世紀是羅馬軍攻城與野戰的火力支援，由軍團各步兵大隊分列攜帶，單具的操作組約需十人上下，有效射程在數百米。它在羅馬手裡拆掉了希臘城牆，也在希臘化東方留下長久印記；到九四三年，這類扭力器械在歐亞已近乎絕跡，羅斯人既不製造也不攜帶，本役現場沒有任何一件羅馬弩砲式的投射機。羅斯戰團真正依賴的裝備是短身複合反曲弓（瓦良格式，射程百五十至二百米，可用於騎射）、單刃直身劍與柄飾、鐵矛、斧、圓盾與大型盾牌、皮甲與鎖子甲（只有貴族與軍頭才有），以及大量從草原換來的馬匹：十世紀的羅斯遠征軍幾乎完全騎兵化，戰士多帶一至二匹備用馬。攻城器械則靠船運：編年史記羅斯人把馬趕上船隻，隨船裝載攻城塔與火攻器具，並以梯子破壞牆基，再用火攻燒燒木構街區；巴達與薛凡一類的土坯與磚石城牆在木構城市裡最怕火，而九四三年春夏之交、裏海沿岸正是乾燥多風的季節。船隻方面，河航用平底駁船改裝的帆船，海航用榫接的松木或柳木船，配單桅或雙桅帆，載人載馬兼載戰利品；陸路用牛車與馬車搬運贖金、物資與俘虜。對面陣營的裝備以哈察爾與阿蘭的騎射弓兵（骨箭與複合箭）為主，守軍另有投石索、石塊，以及用石灰岩與土坯砌成的城牆塔樓；哈察爾人也用投石機與弓箭對付進攻者，說明九世紀的裏海世界並不缺乏投射武器，只是與羅馬式的扭力弩砲分屬不同的技術路線。
kitsEn: The Roman scorpio on this card is a foil for the age of the campaign: a torsion-powered projectile machine, one bolt to a shot, that served as artillery support for Roman siege and field work from the late first century BC into the fifth century AD, carried in sections by the cohorts of a legion, worked by a crew of roughly ten men, and effective to a range of several hundred metres. It broke Greek city walls in Roman hands and left a long mark on the Hellenistic east; by 943 the type had all but vanished from Eurasia. The Rus' neither built nor carried such machines, and no Roman-style torsion ballista appears anywhere in this campaign. What the warband actually relied on was the short composite recurve bow of Varangian type, useful from horseback at a range of one hundred fifty to two hundred metres; single-edged straight swords with decorated hilts; iron spears; axes; round shields and large shields; leather and mail armour, of which only princes and hetmen had any; and large numbers of horses obtained from the steppe, since the tenth-century Rus' expeditionary force was almost entirely mounted, each warrior bringing one or two spare horses. Siege equipment came by boat: the chronicles record the Rus' driving their horses onto the ships and carrying siege towers and fire-lighter gear with them, breaking the wall footings with ladders and then setting fire to the wooden quarters of the town. The mud-brick and rubble walls of Barda and Shirvan were vulnerable in a wooden town, and the Caspian littoral in the spring and early summer of 943 was dry and windy. For shipping, flat-bottomed barges converted into sailing craft on the rivers and clinker-built pine or willow boats with one or two masts on the sea, carrying men, horses and loot alike, while ox carts and wagons moved ransom, goods and captives overland. The enemy relied on the mounted archers of the Khazars and Alans, shooting bone and composite arrows; the garrisons had slings, stones and lime-rendered walls and towers; and the Khazars themselves answered the assault with stone-throwers and bows. The tenth-century Caspian world was not short of missiles; it simply followed a different technological line from the Roman torsion catapult.
tactics: 這是一場以海路機動換取陸地掠奪的戰役，戰術核心是速度、突然，以及靠船運載的有限攻城器械。第一段是集結與下航：各部族部隊在基輔與第聶伯河上游的據點集結，順流南下，船只由奴隸與俘虜划槳，岸上隊伍以每日十至二十公里的行程趕路，穿過草原地帶的牧場與墓地，盡量避開定居點。第二段是分路：船隊走水路，隊伍走陸路，在亞速海與黑海北岸會合，再循海岸東行；多數學者認為他們取的是頓河—亞速海—刻赤海峽—繞克里米亞半島西岸—高加索黑海海岸—裏海這條線，另一派則主張走伏爾加河並利用多納—曼內奇地峽的陸路搬運。船隊進入裏海後並不深入東岸，而是沿西岸與南岸平行航進，先以登陸隊的騎兵襲擊沿線的牧場與哨所，再由主力船隊靠岸攻城，奪取財物、牲畜與俘虜後立即轉移到下一處，避免被守軍合圍包抄。攻城本身是混合手段：靠岸即以雲梯與攻城塔壓迫城牆，同時放火燒燒外圍木構聚落與船塢，再強行登城；史料沒有記載使用任何大型投射機，說明羅斯人無意把羅馬式的重型器械運過半個大陸。第四段是崩潰與撤退：遠征進入裏海後消息走漏，沿岸政權向哈察爾人求援，聯軍在回程必經的隘口與渡口截擊羅斯船隊與陸隊；編年史更記風浪在海上拆散船隊、餘眾落水溺斃，回程進入河口地帶時又遭佩琴涅格人伏擊，大量羅斯人與瓦良格人被殺。倖存的少數人靠小舟與陸路分批逃回，帶回來的是劫掠品與壞消息，而不是版圖。
tacticsEn: This was a campaign in which sea movement was exchanged for land plunder, and its tactical core was speed, surprise, and a limited siege train moved by boat. The first phase was concentration and descent: contingents of different peoples assembled at Kiev and at the strongholds of the upper Dnieper, moved downstream, the boats rowed by slaves and prisoners, while the column on shore marched ten to twenty kilometres a day across steppe pastures and burial grounds, avoiding settlements wherever possible. The second phase was the split into columns: the fleet by water, the army overland, joining on the Sea of Azov and the northern Black Sea coast before moving east along the shore. The majority view holds that they took the line of the Don, the Sea of Azov, the Kerch Strait, a circuit of the Crimean peninsula's western coast, the Caucasian Black Sea shore and then the Caspian; a rival school argues for the Volga with overland transshipment across the Manych Depression. Once inside the Caspian the fleet did not push deep towards the eastern shore but ran parallel along the western and southern coasts, first sending landed cavalry to raid the pastures and watch-posts along the way, then bringing the main force alongside to assault towns, and moving on to the next target as soon as goods, cattle and captives were taken, so as not to be surrounded by the defenders converging. Siege work was a mixture: on arrival ladders and siege towers were pressed against the walls, fires were set to the wooden quarters and the boat yards outside the walls, and the assault was carried by storm; the sources record no large projectile machine of any kind, which shows the Rus' had no intention of hauling Roman-style heavy artillery across half a continent. The fourth phase was collapse and retreat: once the expedition was inside the Caspian the news leaked out, the littoral authorities called on the Khazars for help, and allied forces intercepted the Rus' fleets and columns at the passes and fords their return route had to pass. The chronicles add that storms scattered the fleet at sea and the rest drowned, and that the survivors were ambushed on the way back in the estuary country by the Pechenegs, with many Rus' and Varangians killed. A few survivors made their way back in small boats and on foot, bringing home loot and bad news rather than territory.
data: 可以核對的數字不多，編年史對本役的兵力與傷亡一概未載，只說損失慘重；本文所寫的出動人數、攻城成果與死傷，全部不作精確斷言。地理尺度大致清楚：裏海是地球最大的鹹水湖，水域面積約三十七萬平方公里，南北長約一千二百公里，最大水深逾一千公尺，東岸內陸鹹化，北接伏爾加與烏拉爾河口，西岸是阿蘭與薛凡的港市；刻赤海峽最窄處約四十公里，扼住亞速海通往黑海的水路；頓河全長約一千八百七十公里，第聶伯河約二千二百公里。基輔到巴達的全程，水陸合計超過二千公里，去程順流、返程逆流，體力與時間成本遠高於出發時，是這類遠征最容易崩潰的一環。巴達位於庫拉河（古稱居魯士河）谷地，離裏海西岸約四十至五十公里；薛凡的節爾凡距海更近，約十公里，是黑海—裏海商路的轉口。航線的存在有阿拉伯記述為證：伊本·魯斯塔記載羅斯人沿伏爾加直抵裏海、劫掠哈察爾屬地，馬蘇第《黃金草地》亦記羅斯人的大船與水上習俗。編年史上羅斯人進入裏海另有九一三年一次（本站另有同族卡），九四四年前後再演一次，而斯維亞托斯拉夫的遠征在一〇二二年至一〇二四年，與本役相隔七十九年——中間七十餘年無人重蹈。至於月份，編年史只繫年不繫月，本文取六月為航行季起點，實際出航時間只宜視為約數。
dataEn: Few figures can be verified: the chronicles record no numbers for the troops engaged or for the losses of this campaign, saying only that the destruction was heavy, and nothing here asserts a precise headcount, a precise siege result or a casualty count. The geographical scale is clearer. The Caspian is the largest salt lake on earth, some three hundred and seventy thousand square kilometres of water, about twelve hundred kilometres from north to south, with a maximum depth of more than one thousand metres; its eastern shore is landlocked and saline, its north opens on the mouths of the Volga and the Ural, and its west carries the harbours of Arran and Shirvan. The Kerch Strait is only about forty kilometres wide at its narrowest and commands the water route between the Sea of Azov and the Black Sea; the Don runs for about one thousand eight hundred and seventy kilometres and the Dnieper for about two thousand two hundred. The whole run from Kiev to Barda exceeds two thousand kilometres by land and water combined, downstream going and against the current coming back, so the cost of the return in labour and time was far greater than that of the outward leg and was where expeditions of this kind most easily fell apart. Barda lies in the valley of the Kura, the ancient Cyrus, some forty to fifty kilometres from the western shore of the Caspian; Derbent, the Shirvan capital, stands even closer to the sea, roughly ten kilometres inland, at the transshipment point of the Black Sea-Caspian trade. The route itself is attested in the Arab accounts: Ibn Rustah records Rus' descending the Volga to reach the Caspian and raiding Khazar territory, and Mas'udi's Golden Meadows likewise describes the large Rus' boats and their seafaring customs. The chronicles show another Rus' entry into the Caspian in 913 (a sister card of the same group), the route being repeated again around 944, while Sviatoslav's expedition came in 1022 to 1024, seventy-nine years after this one - seventy-odd years in which nobody repeated the attempt. As for the month, the chronicles give the year but not the month; June is used here as the start of the sailing season, and the actual sailing date should be read as approximate.
cause: 打起來的理由有四層。第一層是經濟：九世紀末至十世紀，裏海東岸通往巴格達、波斯與印度洋的商路是歐亞最賺錢的一段，羅斯人站在這條線的西端，卻只能靠掠奪奪取份額；編年史從不明言羅斯遠征的動機，但每次遠征都帶回大量財物、人口與牲畜，而這些正是基輔公廷維持傭兵、以及向拜占庭餽贈所必需的硬通貨。第二層是航路與中間商：控制頓河下游、伏爾加河口與北高加索的哈察爾汗國自八世紀起就是黑海—裏海之間的守門人，向經過的商隊與船隊徵收什一稅；羅斯人南下，要麼向哈察爾人繳納通行之稅，要麼繞開、甚至直接打擊這道關卡，往裏海最深處推進，正是繞開哈察爾人收稅區的一次嘗試。第三層是安全與依附關係：阿蘭與薛凡的塞人政權站在哈察爾人一邊，在北方人眼中既是攔路者也是追索的來源；打擊他們，等於在哈察爾人的牆上敲一個洞。第四層是經驗的累積：九一三年那次羅斯遠征已證明海路可通，雖然回程慘敗，卻也留下了船期、港口與淡水點的知識；到九四三年，組織一支聯合艦隊與混合騎兵縱隊的技術門檻已不難跨越。另一個不該忽略的背景是拜占庭：羅斯人兩度打到君士坦丁堡的城牆下，始終無法攻破這座由希臘—羅馬傳統與基督徒世界共同守護的都城；正因如此，把劫掠目標從君士坦丁堡的城牆移到裏海沿岸較小的城鎮，是當時性價比最高的選擇。
causeEn: There are four layers of reason behind the fighting. The first is economic: in the late ninth and tenth centuries the trade route from the eastern Caspian to Baghdad, Persia and the Indian Ocean was the most profitable stretch in Eurasia, and the Rus' stood at the western end of it, able to take a share only by plunder. The chronicles never state the motive for the Rus' expeditions outright, but every expedition brought back goods, people and livestock, and those were the hard currency with which the Kiev court paid its retainers and made its gifts to Byzantium. The second layer is the sea lane and the middleman: from the eighth century the Khazar Khaganate, holding the lower Don, the mouth of the Volga and the northern Caucasus, was the gatekeeper between the Black Sea and the Caspian, levying a tithe on the caravans and fleets that passed. When the Rus' moved south they either paid the Khazar passage tax or tried to go around them, or to strike at them directly; the push of 943 deep into the Caspian was precisely an attempt to bypass the Khazar toll zone. The third layer is safety and dependence: the Sasanian-derived polities of Arran and Shirvan stood on the Khazar side of the line and were, in the eyes of the northerners, both an obstacle on the road and a source of demands; hitting them meant knocking a hole in the Khazar wall. The fourth layer is the accumulation of experience: the Rus' expedition of 913 had already shown that the sea route worked, and even though the return was a disaster it left behind knowledge of sailing seasons, harbours and watering points; by 943 the technical threshold for putting together a combined fleet and a mixed mounted column was no longer hard to clear. A further background that cannot be ignored is Byzantium. The Rus' had twice stood beneath the walls of Constantinople and had never broken them, the city being guarded by the Hellenic-Roman tradition together with the Christian world; precisely for that reason, moving the target of plunder from the walls of Constantinople to the smaller towns of the Caspian littoral was the most cost-effective choice available at the time.
impact: 這場遠征的後果並不對稱。對裏海世界：巴達與薛凡一帶的塞人與阿拉伯當局在事後加速加固城牆與塔樓，與哈察爾人建立起更緊密的聯防關係，阿拉伯商人也為商隊加派護衛；裏海東岸通往巴格達方向的商運在若干年內縮減，阿拉伯地理學家在往後的著作裡把「北方人的海盜」寫成裏海航線的常設威脅。對拜占庭：黑海東岸的局勢變得更緊張，帝國在九四五年把羅斯人從劫掠者變成盟軍，授予其在君士坦丁堡的居留與貿易權，羅斯人則接受以傭兵身份為帝國作戰；這份關係是在九四一年的希臘火焚毀羅斯艦隊之後才開始談起，並於九四五年的條約中完成妥協，是羅斯人第一次取得接近君士坦丁堡的合法立足點。對羅斯世界：這類遠征把瓦良格人的航海技術、斯拉夫人的步戰與楚德人的森林游獵經驗綁在同一支隊伍裡，成為羅斯軍事傳統的核心樣板；它同時暴露了遠征軍的結構性弱點——靠劫掠維持、沒有補給線、返程無情報——這些弱點要到十一世紀斯維亞托斯拉夫遠征時才被部分修正。對武器史：九四三年的攻城沒有任何大型投射器械，羅斯人靠火、梯與攻城塔，羅馬式扭力弩砲所代表的攻城機械傳統在歐亞中世紀並未於東歐中斷；東羅斯與伊蘭世界各自發展出配重式與配重加液壓式的巨型投射機，東歐則要等到十五、十六世紀的俄羅斯引入歐洲式火砲與配重投射器，才重新獲得遠程攻城能力。換言之，這場戰役既是羅斯人擴張的一次嘗試，也是一條技術路線的分水嶺。
impactEn: The consequences of this expedition were not symmetrical. For the Caspian world: the Sasanian and Arab authorities around Barda and Shirvan hastened to strengthen walls and towers after the event, built closer joint defence arrangements with the Khazars, and Arab merchants added escorts to their caravans; trade between the eastern Caspian and Baghdad contracted for a number of years, and the Arab geographers of the following centuries wrote the 'raiders from the north' into the record as a standing danger to the Caspian lanes. For Byzantium: the situation in the eastern Black Sea grew tenser, and in 945 the empire turned the Rus' from raiders into allies, granting them residence and trade rights in Constantinople, while the Rus' accepted service as mercenaries in the imperial army. That negotiation only began after Greek fire destroyed the Rus' fleet in 941, and it was completed in the treaty of 945, the first lawful foothold the Rus' obtained close to Constantinople. For the Rus' world: expeditions of this kind bound the seamanship of the Varangians, the infantry work of the Slavs and the forest hunting experience of the Chuds into a single force, and became the core model of Rus' military tradition. At the same time it exposed the structural weaknesses of the expeditionary army - sustained by plunder alone, without supply lines, returning without intelligence - which were only partly corrected by Sviatoslav's campaign in the eleventh century. For the history of weapons: no large projectile machine of any kind appears in the siege work of 943, the Rus' relying on fire, ladders and siege towers, and the tradition of siege machinery represented by the Roman torsion catapult was not interrupted in eastern Europe during the medieval centuries. Byzantium and the Iranian world each developed their own heavy machines, counterweight and counterweight-plus-hydraulic in design, while eastern Europe would not regain long-range siege capability until the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries, when Muscovite Russia imported European cannon and counterweight traction engines. In short, this campaign was both an attempt at Rus' expansion and a watershed between two lines of technical development.
result: 結果是典型的「得手而不得地」：羅斯人一度駛入裏海，攻掠阿蘭的巴達與薛凡沿岸的城邑，奪得財物、牲畜與俘虜，把這條「黑海—裏海—伊朗」的航線從沒有人敢走變成有人走過；但他們沒有留下任何駐軍、城堡或政治影響，裏海的水路控制權仍在哈察爾人與阿拉伯商人手中。回程則是毀滅性的：船隊與陸隊在返航必經的隘口、渡口遭哈察爾與阿蘭聯軍截擊，編年史更記風浪在海上拆散船隊、其餘溺斃，倖存者進入河口地帶時又遭佩切涅格人伏擊，大量羅斯人與瓦良格人被殺，數目不載；少數人靠小舟與陸路分批逃回基輔。此役之後數年，羅斯人再未以整軍艦隊深入裏海，直到一〇二二年至一〇二四年斯維亞托斯拉夫才重啟這條路線，而且這次不只是掠奪，而是沿伏爾加河建立據點、直取哈察爾汗國首都伊提利——說明九四三年既是一次失敗，也是一次必要的實驗：它把這條海路的長度、季節、港口與敵人的反應方式，先用一次慘敗的代價教給了羅斯人。對伊戈爾本人，這場遠征是一次聲望上的重挫；他在一九四五年向德列夫利人索取貢賦時被殺，留下的領地由奧爾加與斯維亞托斯拉夫接手，而黑海—裏海航線在蒙古時期與俄羅斯國家的黑海爭奪中才重新成為焦點。
resultEn: The outcome was the classic pattern of winning everything and holding nothing: the Rus' drove once into the Caspian, raided the towns of Barda in Arran and along the Shirvan coast, and carried off goods, cattle and captives, turning the 'Black Sea-Caspian-Iran' lane from a stretch nobody dared to sail into one that somebody had sailed; but they left behind no garrison, no fortress and no political influence, and control of the Caspian waterway stayed in the hands of the Khazars and the Arab merchants. The return was ruinous. The fleets and columns were intercepted at the passes and fords their homeward route had to cross, the chronicles record storms scattering the ships at sea with the rest drowned, and the survivors were ambushed by the Pechenegs in the estuary country, many Rus' and Varangians being killed, without any number being given; a few made their way back to Kiev in small boats and on foot. For several years afterwards the Rus' no longer sent a formed fleet deep into the Caspian, and the lane was not reopened until Sviatoslav's campaign of 1022 to 1024 - and that time it was not mere plunder, for the Rus' established posts along the Volga and struck at Itil, the capital of the Khazar Khaganate, which shows that 943 was both a defeat and a necessary experiment: it taught the Rus' the length of the sea lane, its seasons, its harbours and the way the enemy reacted, at the price of one ruinous reverse. For Igor himself the expedition was a blow to his standing; he was killed in 945 while collecting tribute from the Drevlians, and the land he left passed to Olga and then to Sviatoslav, while the Black Sea-Caspian lane only became an issue again in the Mongol period and in the struggle of the Russian state for the Black Sea.
